item.title: Driver fatally strikes pedestrian in North Park
item.description: <p>A driver fatally struck a woman Tuesday night in the North Park neighborhood, according to police.</p><p>A 70-year-old man driving westbound in a Chevy SUV hit the woman who was "near the street" about 6:15 p.m. in the 4000 block of West Foster Avenue, Chicago police said in a statement.</p><p>The woman, whose age wasn’t known, was taken to St. Francis Hospital, where she was pronounced dead, police said.</p><p>CPD’s Major Accidents Unit is investigating the crash, police said.</p>
